title: Makita DUB184ST 18V LXT Brushless Cordless Blower | Variable Speed with Cruise Control | 1 x Battery & Charger Included

description: The Makita DUB184ST 18V LXT Brushless Cordless Blower is engineered for powerful, controlled, and emission-free outdoor cleaning in professional and residential environments. It is ideal for resorts, public spaces, workshops, and homes where low noise and zero emissions are important. Driven by a high-efficiency brushless motor, the blower delivers an impressive 52.1 m/s air velocity and 13.0 m³/min air volume, ensuring fast and effective removal of fallen leaves, hedge clippings, and light debris. The axial fan design provides strong airflow while maintaining compact size and improved balance. For better usability, the DUB184ST features variable speed control via trigger combined with a cruise control lock, allowing steady airflow without continuous trigger pressure. When used with an 18V 5.0 Ah battery, it offers up to 10 minutes of continuous run time at the highest speed setting, making it ideal for short, intensive cleaning tasks. Built with Extreme Protection Technology (XPT), the blower offers enhanced resistance to dust and light water exposure, ensuring reliability in harsh outdoor and jobsite conditions. The lightweight body, soft grip handle, and integrated hanging hole further improve comfort and storage convenience. Included in the Box: Cordless blower, nozzle, 1 x 18V 5.0 Ah battery & 18V charger. Warranty: 1 year warranty on tool and 6 months warranty on battery and charger.
